meta.description: Hand-labelled gold set for the Madrid slice. Spain keeps three clean tiers (state CTE -> regional Ley 9/2001 -> municipal PGOUM), and the student room rule is MUNICIPAL: the PGOUM classifies student housing as 'residencia comunitaria'. Mixed ES/EN queries deliberately test bge-m3 cross-lingual retrieval against a Spanish corpus.
meta.corpus: Madrid Phase 1 — 6 documents, 591 chunks (state DB-SUA/HS/SI, regional Ley 9/2001, municipal PGOUM Compendio + FAQ)
meta.match_on: doc_key + article_ref against retrieved chunk metadata. article_ref '*' = doc-level (any chunk from that document counts), satisfied at most once. Doc-level is used throughout because oversized sections are sub-split into '(part N)' refs that are not stable enough to label.
caveats: Author-constructed, not validated by a Spanish planning lawyer — state as a limitation. Every gold_value was verified verbatim against the ingested text.
Doc-level matching, like the London set — NOT directly comparable to the Italian article-level set. Report separately.
The cascade filters on country=ES, so only the 591 Spanish chunks compete.

queries.query: What is the minimum floor area of a bedroom in a student residence in Madrid?
queries.gold_value: One bedroom of 12 m²; the remaining bedrooms of the student residence must be 7 m² (art. 7.3.4.2.c NNUU)
queries.note: THE Spanish student room-size rule — MUNICIPAL tier. Cross-country contrast: Italy=national, London=HMO licensing, Madrid=municipal.

queries.query: ¿Qué superficie mínima debe tener un dormitorio en una residencia de estudiantes?
queries.gold_value: Un dormitorio de 12 m²; el resto de dormitorios 7 m²
queries.note: Same question as es01 in Spanish — same-language vs cross-language comparison.

queries.query: How is collective student accommodation classified in the Madrid urban planning norms?
queries.gold_value: As 'residencia comunitaria' — stable accommodation for groups with religious, social or similar ties (PGOUM Título 7)

queries.query: ¿Qué se entiende por residencia comunitaria en las Normas Urbanísticas?
queries.gold_value: Alojamiento estable de colectivos con vínculos de carácter religioso, social o similar

queries.query: What is the minimum clear width of a door on an accessible route?
queries.gold_value: Anchura libre de paso >= 0,80 m, measured in the frame and provided by no more than one leaf (DB-SUA 9)

queries.query: ¿Cuál es la anchura libre de paso mínima exigida en las puertas de un itinerario accesible?
What minimum ventilation flow rate is required per square metre of habitable floor area?
queries.gold_value: At least 0,7 l/s per m² of usable floor area; 1,5 l/s per habitable room during unoccupied periods (DB-HS 3)

queries.query: What are the fire evacuation and occupant-density requirements for a building?
queries.gold_value: Occupant-density tables, maximum travel distances and exit-width formulas (DB-SI 3, Evacuación de ocupantes)

queries.query: What minimum kitchen area is required in a communal student residence?
queries.gold_value: A communal kitchen of at least 7 m²

queries.query: Must rooms in a student residence be exterior with natural light and ventilation?
queries.gold_value: Yes — must be an exterior room with natural ventilation and lighting (art. 6.7.8 NNUU)

queries.query: What planning procedure governs a change of use of a building in the Community of Madrid?
queries.gold_value: Ley 9/2001 sets the regional planning framework, licence regime and municipal intervention rules

queries.query: ¿Qué licencia urbanística se necesita para cambiar el uso de un edificio?
queries.gold_value: Licencia urbanística conforme a la Ley 9/2001 del Suelo de la Comunidad de Madrid
